whatsapp.ask_trade: Aapko kis kaam ke liye worker chahiye: carpenter, plumber ya electrician?
whatsapp.ask_job_type: Kya kaam karwana hai? Ek line mein batayiye.
whatsapp.ask_problem: Kya problem hai? Ek line mein batayiye.
whatsapp.ask_material: Zaroori saaman (jaise hinge, tap, switch) aapke paas hai, ya worker laaye?
whatsapp.ask_address: Aapka poora address aur paas ka koi landmark bhejiye.
whatsapp.ask_priority: Jab rates aa jaayenge, toh list kis hisaab se lagaun: sabse jaldi aane wala pehle, sabse sasta pehle, ya sabse achhe kaam wala pehle?
whatsapp.card_complete: Shukriya! Ab hum aas-paas ke workers se rate le rahe hain.
whatsapp.change_noted: Aapka badlaav note kar liya hai. Workers ko pehle wali jaankari ke saath contact kiya gaya tha. Nayi jaankari ke hisaab se rate badal sakte hain, lekin worker ki di hui range ke andar hi rahenge.
whatsapp.photo_received: Photo mil gayi, workers ko dikha denge.
whatsapp.no_workers: Maaf kijiye, abhi aapke area mein is kaam ke liye koi worker uplabdh nahi hai.
whatsapp.shortlist_later: {count} aur worker aapke time ke baad aa sakte hain (list mein sabse neeche).
whatsapp.shortlist_no_photo: Yeh rates call pe di gayi jaankari ke hisaab se hain. Photo nahi mili, isliye kaam dekhne ke baad final rate worker ki di hui range ke andar ho sakta hai.
whatsapp.shortlist_footer: Worker chunne ke liye neeche *Worker chuniye* dabaiye.
whatsapp.reason_speed: Yeh bhi jaldi aa sakte hain: {when}
whatsapp.not_chosen_worker: Rate dene ke liye shukriya. Is baar customer ne kisi aur worker ko chuna.
